title: One temporal-flow scalar spans many observational arenas

statements.text: A conserved scalar of temporal-flow differentials, $\chi$, with a few shared parameters, accounts for signatures across gravitational-wave ringdowns, horizon imaging, neutrino transients, precision clocks and cosmology, with gradients that define inertia and gravity.
statements.conditions: The 2026 rebuild requires a parameter to be shared only when one action or constitutive law derives it in every arena.

sources.quote: I posit a conserved scalar of temporal-flow differentials, χ, whose gradients define inertia and gravity
The problem was that numerical similarity and shared notation were allowed to stand in for a derived physical bridge.
